capabilities: Create a command that opens a specific note
Create a command that opens the most recently modified note in a folder, including subfolders
Keep shortcuts working when notes or folders are renamed or moved
Add built-in back and forward navigation commands
Add shortcut commands to the Editing Toolbar for one-tap mobile access
disambiguation: Not a hotkey manager; it creates commands that open notes rather than key bindings.
extras: Manual installation only: the plugin must be built from source (npm run build) and copied into the plugins folder.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to define a command that jumps straight to one chosen note or to the latest note in a folder, which is slow to do on mobile.

relations.evidence: Access a specific note in an instant using editing toolbar plugin.

summary: Command creator that adds commands to open a specific note or the most recently modified note in a folder, usable from the Editing Toolbar on mobile.
